corrected_verdict: PARTIALLY_KNOWN (unchanged). The programme's form is a standard object and its instance and solution are new. Inverted, Gamma_s(p)^{-1/s} = min{sum_j y_j^{1/s} : sum_j y_j(1-cos(2 pi j delta/p)) >= 1 for all delta != 0, y >= 0}. That is l_q quasi-norm minimisation (q=1/s<1) over a covering polyhedron, as in Ge-Jiang-Ye 2011, whose Thm 3 says basic feasible solutions are exactly the local minimisers. So the claim that a concave budget gives a sparse optimum is classical. The new part is the circulant cosine-coverage instance, the bound on every network, and K*=Theta(log p).

Gunasekar 2018 is confirmed via the arXiv abstract ('l_{2/L} bridge penalty in the frequency domain'). Jagadeesan 2022 and Boyd 2006 metadata are confirmed.
(5) Chowla cosine problem: a different extremum, no overlap. This agrees with the checker.
